parsed.name: UP20超声探头
parsed.description: 用于超声成像的USB探头设备，可通过USB控制传输与批量传输进行初始化、寄存器配置、图像采集、冻结/解冻、原始图像读取以及多普勒相关采集控制，适用于实验中的超声观察与数据获取。
parsed.description_en: A USB ultrasound probe used for ultrasound imaging. It is controlled through USB control and bulk transfers for initialization, register configuration, image acquisition, freeze/unfreeze operation, raw image retrieval, and Doppler-related acquisition, making it suitable for experimental ultrasound observation and data capture.
